meta.title: The Missing Page
meta.textType: story: a club book with a contents page

paragraphs: On Monday, November thirtieth, Teacher Kim gave each Explorer a printed copy of the November Book. They sat in the school library. It was a class project, and it looked like a small magazine. "Please check every page," she said, "and keep your copy safe." The first page was a contents page. It listed six articles, and each article had a title and a page number. The aquarium leaflet was on page two, and the shy octopus was on page four. Mia's article about seahorses was on page six. The pool rules from a pen pal were on page eight. A badminton email was on page ten. Leo's cartoon was on page twelve. "My cartoon is last," said Leo, "because the best part comes at the end."

That evening, Lily sat on the floor at home with her copy. She made two groups of pages and read the title of each page. Soon she stopped. "One page is missing," she said to herself. "Which article is on page six?" She looked at the contents page, and it answered at once. "It is Mia's seahorse article." "Where did the page disappear?"

Lily looked around the room. Pip lay under the sofa with his red ball. A white corner of paper stuck out beside him. "Pip, give me that paper, please," said Lily. Pip wanted to keep the ball and the paper. Pip held the paper in his mouth for a long time. Lily pulled the paper gently. It was page six, but it was too wet to read.

Lily laughed and found Mia's post on the blog. "I can print a new page six," she said. She printed the page and read the first paragraph of the article. Then she put the new page in the book. She finished her check at eight o'clock. After that, she uploaded the web page of the book to the blog. Teacher Kim read it first the next morning, and then it went online.

Before bed, Lily called Mia on the phone. "A page was missing, but I found it," she said. "The contents page showed me the missing page at once." "Was it my page?" asked Mia. "Yes, it was page six," said Lily. "But the new page is not as wet as the old one." Mia laughed. Lily put the book in her bag and smiled at Pip.
text.summary: Teacher Kim gives each Explorer a printed copy of the November Book to check. At home Lily finds that one page is missing, and the contents page shows which one. Pip has the page, so Lily prints a new one.
